A later separately approved initial full run must reconcile actual run/attempt repository/workflow/ref/head, all five distinct job source identities, retained checkout logs and ownership head/tree/task against the actual future desired SHA/tree. Names, branch snapshots or focused preflight cannot replace actual checkout evidence.

Only common desktop-android has fetch-depth0. iOS full and three desktop jobs have depth1. The history-dependent inventory gate is correctly routed to the full-history common job; Windows Git identity is not a claim of Linux-identical newline-normalized checkout bytes.

Android productionAndroidRuntimeCheck delegates to pixel2Api35ReleaseAndroidTest through the task-owned synthetic-signing managed-device script. Static/resource/unsigned-AAB/package checks, Kotlin Native distribution download and linkage are not runtime evidence.

Restored XML, aggregate success, declarations or a linked/retained XCResult directory are not newly executed tests. Reused evidence requires exact source/control/platform/scope applicability; unresolved freshness gaps stay visible.

artifact_and_cleanup_conclusions: Successful full qualification requires all five actual required jobs/checks, ten attributable nonempty original main/cleanup artifacts and independent raw-evidence reconciliation. Uploads use14-day retention and warn on no files; successful upload steps or artifact names alone cannot satisfy completeness or custody.

Collection must retain paginated API identities, original ZIP sizes/digests and safe member inventories/extracted hashes, command exits/times and run/attempt/job association without secrets. No overwrite of failed or unrelated evidence; absent artifacts/reports after failure remain gaps or NOT_RUN.

Main iOS upload includes reports, XCResult and optional dSYM, not Parlor.app or an IPA. Actual Release binary hash/notices/package-inventory receipts are not an invented retained or Store-signed application.

All jobs use prepared head/tree/task/output-root claims, immediate configured Gradle stops and final custody-gated cleanup. Final deletion requires stop0, unchanged source/output authority and positive artifact ID/64hex digest after upload. Inspect errors/retained/removed/not_created; never infer clean resources from an Actions conclusion.

Apple aggregate/UI/wrapper finishes must each reconcile actual prepare/run/finish outcomes, source/task/claim hashes, stop first, bounded native-worker quiescence before/after simulator cleanup and exact owned-UUID retirement. Legitimate NOT_RUN cleanup requires skipped prepare/run and no claim, and never upgrades an unexecuted required test.

Non-Apple cleanup only attests Gradle/in-process Kotlin scope. Emulator/other native retirement needs separate actual evidence; generic Gradle or orphan cleanup cannot establish it. Missing native/device cleanup evidence remains a qualification limitation even if ordinary output cleanup succeeds.
